summary: Ran comprehensive backend + frontend integration tests for Conflux (Go + MariaDB + vanilla JS). 16/16 backend pytest cases pass covering health/bootstrap, auth (admin login, first-user-admin, new user NOT admin, invalid creds, registration validation), feeds (add/list/subscribe/items), posts (create/timeline/react/comment/reply/delete/repost/quote/share), users/follow, and profile update. Frontend Playwright walk-through succeeded: signup UI registers a fresh user (no ADMIN badge), home composer posts, Explore adds https://hnrss.org/frontpage feed with 20 items, All items and Subscribed tabs work, People page follow works, Profile shows counts + Edit profile, theme toggle switches to dark, FAB compose opens dialog, snackbars appear ('Posted', 'Welcome, ...'), no console/pageerror events, no error-class DOM nodes.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.go handleRegister: race condition between the SELECT COUNT(*) and INSERT — two simultaneous first registrations could both see count=0 and both be flagged admin. Wrap in a transaction or rely on a unique 'is_admin' constraint / seed script. Not exploitable in preview because admin is already seeded.
social.go counts() runs 3-4 queries per card; timeline renders 20 posts => 80+ round-trips per page. Consider batching or a single JOIN with GROUP BY for scale.
main.go CORS uses Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * which is fine for token auth but blocks any future cookie/httpOnly auth work — worth documenting.

feeds subscribed filter and timeline 'following' filter query strings should be validated against an allowlist; currently a stray value silently falls back to defaults, which is OK but worth explicit handling.
In web/js/app.js the item card click navigates via hash router; ensure item detail view has a data-testid on the container for easier E2E hooks (item-detail-<id>).
test_credentials: admin@conflux.app / admin123 (admin, pre-seeded). New user registered dynamically via signup UI.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates one TEST_ user (test_<uuid8>@example.com / password123) plus one TEST_post, comments, repost, quote, share and follow relationships. No cleanup — data is stable and harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is https://feed-share-110.preview.emergentagent.com; API prefix /api. Feed add payload uses field name 'feed_url' (not 'url'). Reliable feed for testing: https://hnrss.org/frontpage (NASA feed is rate-limited 429). Reactions require target_type in {post, feed_item, comment}, reaction in {like,love,celebrate,insightful,laugh}. Existing pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and can be run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced. Only a test-side fix was needed: initial feed POST used {url:...} but the Go API expects {feed_url:...} per feeds.go handleAddFeed. Corrected in the test file.
